_doc: Per-concept settings (no code changes needed). rerank.colour: HSV range (H in degrees 0-360, S and V 0-255) whose pixel fraction per 14 px patch is blended into the re-rank score with rerank.colour_weight; patch_weight scales DINOv2 patch similarity. count_conf: confidence threshold for counting a result as a detected object.

change._doc: Cross-year cell similarity is the primary signal (radiometry differs between NAIP years, so colour then is only supporting evidence). new = colour now >= colour_now_min AND sim <= sim_new_max; existing = sim >= sim_existing_min OR colour then >= colour_then_keep x colour now; else unsure.

dense._disabled_doc: Uptown dense additions were ~7/50 right by eye (tall-building shadows/roof edges; data/out/shadow_Uptown_additions.png), so dense is off there

shadow._doc: A/B 2026-11-08: removes 2 of 112 (Ballantyne) and 1 of 52 (Uptown) dense objects, < 3/50 gain: kept off

dense._doc: Dense proposals are concept-colour blobs that passed the object check; at query time they only need DINOv2 similarity ≥ sim_min and to be closer to the picked examples than to the not-this negatives.

object_check._doc: SAM outlines of pools often include the deck/yard, so with outline_by_colour the final outline = SAM mask ∩ pool-cyan pixels (dilated 1 px), the connected piece at the prompt. Area range, compactness and colour fraction are checked on that refined outline.

solar_installation._doc: Solar verifier (2026-11-08, docs/COMPUTER_VISION_EVALUATION.md#solar). The old colour (H190-250, S>=30, V<=110) matched 0% of the pixels of known NAIP blue panel arrays but 7% of all pixels: it was a SHADOW detector (34,178 'objects' in Huntersville, 0/48 solar by eye, 99% never checked because only SAM-outlined objects were checked). NAIP 2022 panels are mid-bright blue (colour below: 55% of known array pixels, 0.23% of all pixels). Every detection is now verified before it is counted (verify_pending), and again on its SAM outline (object_check).
solar_installation.experimental: solar verifier is rule-based (panel colour, on a roof or a large array, lidar height where built); engineer eye-check only, no human reviews yet; bright grey ground-mount panels are not detected

any_of._doc: rooftop array: on an Overture footprint, raised (lidar, where built)
large ground-mount / carport array: >= 1000 m2 of connected panel-colour patches

verify_pending._doc: Checked on the detection's 8.4 m patch box before any SAM outline exists (area = the scan's connected patch group). Observed false positives: canopy shadows (vegetation), lawn/road shadows and asphalt (not on a building), blue courts (small, off-roof). require_outline: a box that passes is queued for SAM but only counted once its outline passes object_check (blue-grey roofs pass every box rule).

object_check._doc: On the SAM outline refined to panel-colour pixels: area, compactness, panel-colour fraction/area, not vegetation, rectangular (arrays are rectangles: 0.85-0.88 on known arrays; whole house roofs 0.6-0.8), covering at most 60% of its building footprint (a blue-grey roof is the whole footprint; known arrays cover ~30%), different from the rest of its roof (median saturation/brightness distance >= 50: known arrays 77-82, blue-grey roof planes and dark membrane roofs 2-45; not measurable on a roof = fail), and on a roof (lidar-raised where built) or a large array. Tuned on Huntersville false positives + the South End arrays; Matthews and Uptown are the holdout.

parking_lot.experimental: under-counts large lots (Uptown 6 counted vs 407 in OSM); a lot detector / area inventory is pending (Phase 3/7)
